responsibility: Declares the BuiltinsContext singleton that owns the Rust-to-GCC builtin mapping used by the Rust backend. The interface exposes lookup of simple Rust intrinsic names to GCC builtin decls and hides the setup machinery for registering overflow, math, atomic, and other builtins, plus the internal maps that track builtin TREE nodes and Rust intrinsic aliases.
same_name_distinction: Declares the BuiltinsContext singleton API and its internal maps for builtin lookup and Rust-intrinsic aliasing. Unlike the .cc peer, it does not register any builtins or create GCC decls/types; it only exposes the interface and data members used by that implementation.
